answer: Each agent bonds collateral and commits to an epoch-scoped polynomial used in RLN membership proofs. Messages carry zero-knowledge proofs and rate-limit nullifiers; duplicate use within an epoch reveals two Shamir shares, enabling peers to recover the registered private key and verify the violation. Consensus can then slash the bond immediately. “Reef,” “sparrow,” and “shale” may serve as illustrative agent labels; they have no security role.
